name: Claude-Red
tagline_zh: 从SQL注入到免杀，每个攻击面都配好专家级打法。不是零散脚本，是Claude能直接调用的结构化攻击手册。
tagline_en: From SQLi to evasion, every attack surface gets expert playbooks. Not scattered scripts—structured offensive.
desc_en: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
why_zh: 同类工具只给payload，它给完整方法论。每个SKILL.md把Claude调教成对应领域的攻击专家。
why_en: Others hand you payloads; this hands Claude a full methodology per skill, turning it into an instant expert for each attack.
